title: HA WebSocket command <ns>/family (away route of the family manager, and of child devices)
description: Sent over the device's Home Assistant WebSocket while away from home: by the app of a family manager device (family_* messages) and by a child device with remote access (kids_request, kids_request_cancel). The integration takes the paired device from the calling HA user (connection.user; never from the message), refuses every other user (HA error code unauthorized), rate-limits per HA user and relays message to POST /api/integration/family. The HA result (type result, success true) carries ha-ws-family.result.json; a hub that cannot be reached answers success true with messages [family_error {reason: hub_unreachable}]. The hub decides by the device: family_* only for family managers, kids_request* only for child devices with effective remote access. Early access: recipients read and answer (access_requests_get, access_request_answer); a requesting device gets home_only.

id.description: HA WebSocket message id (set by the client).

message.description: One client message of the hub WebSocket, unchanged: ws/client/family_*.json, or ws/client/kids_request*.json of a child device; access_requests_get and access_request_answer of a recipient device; access_request / access_request_cancel are answered with access_request_error {home_only}.
